storyTitle: Review Statement Credit and Holiday Goal Progress
oneSentenceStory: Daniel reviews his 7,300 coin balance and applies statement credits toward his active Holiday Spending Money goal.
customerSituation: Daniel visits the rewards overview to check his accumulated balance and monitor his holiday savings.
storyTension: Ensuring transparent cash value translation without unnecessary gamification or irrelevant partner vouchers.
customerResolution: Clear visibility of statement credit options and direct progress tracking toward bill reduction.
primaryOutcome: Seamless review and application of statement credits to reduce monthly card bills.
